shape_ceiling_arithmetic_registered_befo.note: AI is below the crossover, so the binding roof for these two shapes is TRAFFIC, not arithmetic. The dense 122.29 cube is NOT their ceiling. 35.49 needs 79.2 % of the measured DRAM roof at this AI.

decision_rules.dram_path_is_the_term: both_l1 lifts A_ship above 35.49 TFLOP/s -> the DRAM path binds and a residency/fusion mechanism exists; campaign continues.
decision_rules.math_is_the_term: fid_lofi lifts A_ship by more than 1.5x -> the FPU is issuing at its fidelity limit and math binds.
decision_rules.neither: no arm lifts A_ship above 25 TFLOP/s -> the term is per-output-tile pipeline cost, not bandwidth and not FPU issue. Report the measured ceiling and STOP.
decision_rules.thin_k_structural: the K ladder asymptote is the achievable rate at these M,N. Asymptote > 2x the K=128 rate CONFIRMS thin-K as structural; within 20 % of it REFUTES thin-K as the term.
decision_rules.batch_loop: flat2d moves A_ship by more than 10 % -> the leading batch dim, not K, carries the loss (same FLOPs, same compulsory bytes, no batch loop).
